title: SWF: full MATRIX transform in PlaceObject2/3
description: Extend encodePlaceObject2 (and PlaceObject3) in packages/swf/src/shapes.ts to support scale, rotation, and skew via the Matrix2D/toSWFMatrix utilities from @flash/core. Add encodePlaceObject2WithTransform(charId, depth, x, y, scaleX?, scaleY?, rotation?) overload. Update compile.ts to pass ShapeDisplayObject transform fields (scaleX, scaleY, rotation) when present. Purely packages/swf/ — import toSWFMatrix from @flash/core.
